conditions.label: Has employees
conditions.description: Pays wages or salaries and runs a payroll.

conditions.label: Registered for VAT
conditions.description: Registered for value added tax or a similar turnover tax.

profileFields.label: Company name
profileFields.description: The registered name, including the SAS legal form. A joint-stock company with governance rules set by its statutes.

profileFields.label: Numéro RCCM
profileFields.description: The number the company register gave the company.

profileFields.label: Registered office address
profileFields.description: The address on the company register.

profileFields.label: Capital social
profileFields.description: The capital the company was registered with. Leave it empty if the form has no share capital.

roles.label: Director
roles.description: Runs the company and represents it.

roles.label: Shareholder
roles.description: Owns shares or a stake in the company.

setupSteps.title: Choose and check the SAS name
setupSteps.description: Check the name is free in Fichier National du Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier and follows Burkina Faso's naming rules.
setupSteps.authority: Fichier National du Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier

setupSteps.title: Prepare the SAS documents
setupSteps.description: Prepare the articles or statutes, the founders' details and the registered office. The registration process sets out what it needs.
setupSteps.authority: Fichier National du Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier

setupSteps.title: Register the SAS
setupSteps.description: Submit the incorporation documents as Fichier National du Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier requires. The company exists once the register enters it.
setupSteps.authority: Fichier National du Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier

setupSteps.title: Register the SAS for tax
setupSteps.description: Register with Direction Générale des Impôts for the company's tax number and any VAT or payroll accounts it needs.

setupSteps.title: Register as an employer
setupSteps.description: Before the first hire, register with Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale for payroll and social contributions.

setupSteps.title: Open a business bank account
setupSteps.description: Banks usually ask for the registration certificate and the tax number.

setupSteps.title: Check licences for your activity
setupSteps.description: Some activities need a permit or a licence from a sector regulator. Check before you start trading.

obligations.title: Annual return or confirmation statement
obligations.description: Check whether an annual return or confirmation statement is due with Fichier National du Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier, then file it and keep the company record current.
obligations.authority: Fichier National du Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier

obligations.title: Annual financial statements
obligations.description: Prepare the annual accounts. Check whether they must be filed with Fichier National du Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier, the deadline and whether an audit is required.
obligations.authority: Fichier National du Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier

obligations.title: Corporate income tax return
obligations.description: Check the company's income tax filing with Direction Générale des Impôts, then file the return and pay by the dates it sets.

obligations.title: VAT returns
obligations.description: File VAT returns with Direction Générale des Impôts and pay any VAT due. Check whether the company is registered and how often it files.

obligations.title: Payroll taxes and social contributions
obligations.description: Withhold and remit payroll taxes and social contributions for employees through Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale. Check the rates and dates.

obligations.title: Beneficial ownership information
obligations.description: Check whether the country requires a beneficial ownership filing. If it does, keep the record up to date and file it with Fichier National du Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier.
obligations.authority: Fichier National du Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier

obligations.title: Report changes to the register
obligations.description: Check what changes must be reported to Fichier National du Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier, then tell it about changes to the name, address, directors or share capital within its deadline.
obligations.authority: Fichier National du Registre du Commerce et du Crédit Mobilier

obligations.title: Renew licences and permits
obligations.description: Check which licences your activity needs and renew them before they expire.
